profile.headline: Software Developer at GE Aerospace
profile.geoLocationName: Olde West Chester, Ohio, United States
profile.summary:
Avid learner • Critical thinker • Analytical • Logically-minded • Process-driven • Embrace challenge

I'm transitioning from a background in insurance underwriting/sales and nanotechnology research to a career in software development that encapsulates my greatest strengths. I've always been passionate about computers and technology, dating back to my high school years when I built my own PC's. After spending a year as a stay-at-home dad, I put my faith in Cincy Code IT's full stack Java developer boot camp to guide my learning and haven't looked back.

CERTIFICATES: 
Full Stack Java Developer Boot camp, Cincy Code IT (Mason, OH) - 2018
Lean-Ergonomics for Manufacturing Certificate, Wright State University (Dayton, OH), Six Sigma, Lean/kaizen tools and techniques.
Certificate of Training for Signals Intelligence Analyst, Advanced Technical Intelligence Center (Beavercreek, OH). Completed intelligence analyst curriculum including: ELINT; OPIR; AGI; SAR; ArcGIS, MARTES and MATLAB.

STRENGTHS identified through Gallup’s Strength Finder 2.0:
Achiever - exhibit a great deal of stamina and work hard to achieve results
Analytical - ability to think about all the factors that might affect a situation
Learner - great desire to learn and continuously improve
Competition - strive for the best results
Harmony - work well with others.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
While at GE Aerospace, I collaborated with small teams in the Digital Technology Commercial Engine Services (CES) division to develop backend REST APIs using Java and Spring Boot, build UI components with VueJS, and plan data migrations to support standalone applications for the Customer Portals team.

Key highlights include:

- Connected distributed databases to enable commercial engine customers to place orders for new or used engine parts, request engine repairs, and track returns.

- Built a tool to help recover revenue for warranty work performed on engines in collaboration with joint venture partners.

- Planned the migration of data from an Oracle database to SAP's Vistex platform for managing warranty claims.

- Served as the lead developer on a project to migrate technical publications from a MongoDB (NoSQL) database to a PostgreSQL (SQL) database, an S3 bucket, and an OpenSearch index hosted in AWS. This included developing VueJS UI components to support admin functionality for adding and modifying publications via the backend APIs.

These projects involved backend development, database management, AWS integration (e.g., Lambda, CodePipeline, Secrets Manager, S3), writing unit and integration tests, conducting peer code reviews, and mentoring junior developers.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Boot · Node.js · PostgreSQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Vue.js · Oracle Database

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed solutions for the warehouse and order-fulfillment industry using a full-stack of Java with Spring Boot, SQL (SQL Server, Sybase), and Angular (Typescript). Built backend REST API's and UI for warehouse clients to build and track orders as they are being processed and ultimately shipped. Traveled on-site to the customer warehouse locations to deploy software and perform integration testing with multiple vendors, and provided post-production support as needed.

positions.title: Underwriter/Rating Analyst
positions.description: Researched and entered data for conversion of 8,000+ policies to XyCor database and performed quality control. Developed software training materials for team members to improve speed and accuracy of conversion process. Reduced processing time from 4-6 hours to 5 min by developing quoting macro files for policy data entry. Resolved certificate rating errors for lender-placed products of risk, to ensure compliance and reduce future discrepancies with agent.

positions.title: Health Plan Advisor
positions.description: Retained over 85% business from in-bound calls from individual members at-risk of cancellation. Advised and educated members on current state of healthcare reform and resold value of Anthem products to the under 65 market. Resolved members needs with appropriate products and facilitated re-enrollment by utilizing multiple programs including SalesForce, Producer Toolbox and Siebel.

positions.title: Graduate Researcher
positions.description: Conducted research at Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) in the Biological and Nanostructured Materials division. Synthesized monodisperse gold nanoparticles and characterized the surface behavior of gold nanoparticles through use of x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) and scanning electron microscopy (SEM).

company.name: Southwestern Ohio Council for Higher Education

positions.title: Summer Research Intern
positions.description: Collaborative research effort between Wright State University and Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) Sensors Directorate. Utilized animation and computational fluid dynamics (CFD) software to compile thermal signature database for a human in motion. Presented research findings at 5th Annual Dayton Engineering Sciences Symposium (DESS), sponsored by American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME)-October 26, 2009.

positions.title: Supervising Agent
positions.description: AIL provides life and supplemental health benefits to unions. Supervised and trained team of agents. Conducted sales presentations, needs analysis and risk assessment of clientele. Networked to generate new leads with non-union organizations.
